LESSON: JACOB WRESTLES AN ANGEL

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.5: Jacob Wrestles an Angel

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Jacob Wrestles an Angel
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how they apply lessons learnt in their lives • compose and say a prayer to God. Why is it good to pray always?

1. identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model A for “identify values learnt from the story of Jacob” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify values learnt from the story of Jacob” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify values learnt from the story of Jacob" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify values learnt from the story of Jacob

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT
